channel.title: Pier & Point · Potrero Power Station Block 1
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Potrero Power Station Block 1 (Potrero Power Station), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 1: Block 1's page now says the block lies entirely inside active Assessor lot 4175500 (1248 Georgia Ln, added October 15, 2024), a larger lot that is not Block 1's own, and no longer describes the ground condition. The 2018 draft EIR's reference to Assessor lot 4175018 is presented as 2018 ownership; DataSF now lists that lot as retired.

item.title: Expected · Potrero Power Station Block 1: Completion expected: Block 1 is in Phase 2 of the October 2020 re-phased program; SocketSite's block-by-block schedule for that program shows vertical development on Block 1 from 2029 to 2031; a 2020 forecast that the 2026 Phasing Plan amendments (see below) may have superseded (~2031)
item.description: Completion expected: Block 1 is in Phase 2 of the October 2020 re-phased program; SocketSite's block-by-block schedule for that program shows vertical development on Block 1 from 2029 to 2031; a 2020 forecast that the 2026 Phasing Plan amendments (see below) may have superseded (~2031). Source: SF Planning, 2020-10-07; SocketSite, 2020-10-09; SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-10-06; SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-09-28.

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 1: Block 1's heights now follow the colour-coded labels on the Design for Development's Figure 6.2.3 (180 ft maximum with an 85 ft base on the west part, 85 ft on the east part); the earlier '115 ft' was a plan-dimension line, not a height. The expected completion changed from the 2035 whole-project date to 2031: the October 2020 Phase 1 approval places Block 1 in Phase 2 and SocketSite's schedule table shows vertical development 2029-2031 (a 2020 forecast). The earlier statement that no source supports a Public Library option here was removed: the Phase 1 approval moves that option to Block 1. The dead August 2019 draft Design for Development link was replaced with the final February 2020 document, the land-use figure is now tagged as a document rather than a rendering, and publisher names on source entries were corrected.

item.title: Planned · Potrero Power Station Block 1: Board of Supervisors approves the Potrero Power Station project and Development Agreement (Ordinance No. 62-20, Board File 200040), the entitlement covering the adopted Design for Development, whose Land Use Table (Table 3.1.1) lists Block 1 as a development block; the Development Agreement's own effective date is May 25, 2020, distinct from the D4D's own February 26, 2020 final-document date (Apr 21, 2020)

Source: Port of San Francisco, 2025-11-14; SF Planning; SF Planning (document adopted by the Planning Commission; the D4D names no publisher), 2020-02-26.
